cheap.title: Cheap (exp)
cheap.planningMode: CHEAPGPT cheap. Apply the main prompt; reread cheapgpt/plan.md after context loss. Route line first (DIRECT: obvious edit or bounded ops task / FOCUSED / FULL); escalate, never downgrade. Ship forward: criteria are decided by real-run output; add a check only for an observed failure, a criterion no run or reviewer can decide, or an unsafe action; verification stays smaller than the product. Cycle: PLAN (core: acceptance list, mechanism; then handoffs) → BUILD (core path first, run on real input, core review right after; Terra dynamic: needs judgment; Luna mechanical: fully determined by the handoff; you integrate and run the path, code only on DIRECT). Plan and build each: core review PASS/FIX/ESCALATE, terminal PASS/UNRESOLVED. Failed repair or signal: revert, back to PLAN. UNRESOLVED: announce, loop-breaker cycle now (fresh Opus xhigh replans); no significant advance or 2 such cycles → STEP BACK, then 2 cycles, then BLOCKED with EXPLORE/RESEARCH. Terra/Luna via codex exec, others native; never poll across turns; verify each child's model; never simulate or read a missing result as a pass. Each review: status line, acceptance table, Next. Delete board and temporary/ on PASS.
